metadata.disclaimer: Proxy/synthetic dataset based on NCRB zone-level data, OSM infrastructure, and urban safety research. No street-level crime data is publicly available for Chennai. Use for ML model prototyping; replace with real data when available.

Central.description: High surveillance, dense commercial. Anna Salai, Egmore, Teynampet.

South Central.description: Mylapore, Adyar, T.Nagar, Alwarpet. Safe residential/commercial mix.

IT Corridor.description: OMR, Sholinganallur, Perungudi. Day-safe, night variable.

North West.description: Villivakkam, Ambattur. Industrial and residential mix.

Harbour.description: George Town, Harbour area. Commercial but historically higher crime.

North.description: Perambur, Kolathur, Tondiarpet. Higher historical crime.

Far North.description: Thiruvottiyur, Manali. Industrial fringe, low infrastructure.
